$comment: Which model and thinking effort each kind of agent starts on (ADR 0057 tiers, ADR 0062 efforts), at each priority a person can choose on the Agents' models slider (ADR 0112): Saving, Balance or Highest quality. The one table: the app reads it in ui/src/lib/ai/modelIds.ts for templates, the builder, new agents and every model suggestion, and the daemon reads it for Ask's list_models, its jobs and LoomWatch's own check, so every way of making an agent chooses alike. The table at the top is Highest quality, and it stays as ruled (2026-10-18): every job that gathers for the work, produces it, decides it or checks it is on the strong or check tier. `priorities` says only what Balance and Saving change from it; a tier, job, kind or plan they don't name is as Highest quality has it. `jobModels` is a job's own pick at that priority, where public evaluations show a model does that work nearly as well for much less (ADR 0112 lists the evidence); when nothing connected can run it, the job's tier stands in. `defaultPriority` is what a new install starts on: moving it to balance is a one-line change here, to make once the quality benchmark shows the work stays as good. `models` name each tier's model first, as OpenRouter ids; who pays for it comes after (ADR 0073, ruled 2026-10-19): a connected plan that offers it (the Claude API credit for Anthropic's models, the ChatGPT plan for OpenAI's), else OpenRouter. Only when neither can run it does a connected plan's own model for the tier stand in: `bySource` names it, and `preference` says which connected plan's comes first. `kinds` are the kinds of work a reading of an agent's setup tells apart (gather, produce, check), for an agent no built-in job places; a job's `kind` says the same of it.

tiers.strong: an agent that gathers what the work rests on, writes it, decides it or reviews it: research, writing, designing, leading, analysis, code
tiers.fast: short supporting work that judgement does not hang on: reformatting, simple lookups
tiers.check: a check step, read on another maker's model so it doesn't share the writer's blind spots
